## The claim

The blind target set contains at least one gene whose curated disease is a recessive chromosome-instability syndrome.

**Prediction if true.** At least one target-set gene has an OMIM/HPO-curated recessive disease annotated at or under HP:0002916 (chromosome segregation) or HP:0003220 (chromosome stability).

**What would refute it.** No target-set gene has such a disease — the symptom ranking and the mechanism-term rule together nominate no chromosome-instability gene.
